_comment: Heuristics configuration for the mechanical triage activity (src/activities/triage.py). Adjust limits to balance LLM context quality against resource usage.

file_extraction._comment_readme: Glob patterns (relative to repo root) matched for README files.
file_extraction._comment_docs: Directory names considered documentation roots. Searched recursively.
file_extraction._comment_docs_extensions: File extensions extracted from docs directories.
file_extraction._comment_build: Build/metadata filenames extracted from anywhere in the repo.

size_limits._comment: Guards to prevent resource exhaustion during triage.

clone_limits._comment: Shallow clone constraints. Exceeding size_mb triggers manual triage routing.

exclude_patterns._comment: Directory and file patterns to skip during os.walk traversal.
